batch.description: Ordered Blueprint/graph/component actions sharing one durable journal, without automatic rollback/retry.

tools.description:
Execute 1..100 explicitly supported Blueprint/graph/component actions in order on the game thread.

        Args:
            commands_json: JSON array of {"type":"CubelessBlueprintTools.create_blueprint","params":{"name":"BP_Name","parent_class":"Actor","package_path":"/Game/Blueprints"}} entries. Allowed CubelessBlueprintTools functions: create_blueprint, inspect_blueprint, compile_blueprint, compile_and_save_blueprint, compile_and_validate_blueprint, add_blueprint_variable, inspect_blueprint_variables, inspect_blueprint_variable_metadata, set_blueprint_variable_default. Allowed CubelessBlueprintGraphTools functions: inspect_graph, add_branch_node, set_node_position, delete_node, connect_graph_pins, add_blueprint_variable_get_node, add_blueprint_variable_set_node, resolve_blueprint_graph, add_blueprint_function_parameter, add_blueprint_call_function_node. Function actions use existing selectors and strict JSON adapters, with native unsupported options rejected before mutation; create a function graph in a separate resolve action before adding its input/call node. They perform no explicit full compile/save. Graph selectors accept object-path node_id or native GUID; direct typed links preserve existing topology and refuse conversion/promotion nodes or link replacement. Member-node tools initially support locally declared variables only. Allowed CubelessComponentTools functions: list_blueprint_components, get_component_property, add_component_to_blueprint, set_component_property, set_static_mesh_properties, set_physics_properties. Use each individual tool's exact parameters/defaults except operation_id, which belongs only to the whole batch. Set component add compile_blueprint=false and variable default compile=false/save=false to accumulate edits before one final named compile/save action. Variable adds never request full compile/save; dry_run retains requested flags but executes neither. The named mesh setter accepts material for slot 0; material-only edits require static_mesh as an explicit empty string plus a valid material path. Omitted/null material preserves existing mesh-only batch replay. Physics defaults request no compile/save or running simulation; numeric int/float inputs normalize to numbers without the int32 coordinate restriction. Up to 1 MiB input. No legacy aliases, result references, arbitrary tools or nested batches. All command names/types are checked before any action. Individual domain restrictions still apply.
            stop_on_error: Defaults True. False continues only known failures; uncertain mutation, journal failure, PIE/session guard, or the 15-second between-step budget always stops. One engine call cannot be preempted.
            operation_id: Durable whole-batch ID; omitted/null generates a returned ID. Same ID and normalized inputs replay the recorded response without rerunning. Interrupted IDs never resume automatically.

        The named duplicate_blueprint_to_temp action is also supported under CubelessBlueprintTools with its individual defaults (dry_run=True, compile=False, save=True). It requires a clean saved source and SaveOnCompile=Never/source-control-disabled policy; engine implicit PostDuplicate compilation is separately reported. Overwrite and dirty-source cloning remain unsupported. It uses this batch journal, never a nested operation/retry.

        CubelessBlueprintGraphTools.add_blueprint_sequence_node is supported with its individual defaults and JSON position adapter; it adds 2..64 ordered exec outputs to an existing selected graph without compiler/save calls. It preserves GUID-valued node_id plus object_path. Its shared creation core and the existing Branch tool verify old graph topology. All domain limitations still apply.

        CubelessBlueprintGraphTools.connect_blueprint_graph_pins preserves legacy source_pin/target_pin and graph selectors, sharing the ordinary connection core. Replacement requires allow_pin_link_replacement=true and all four expected fields naming exactly one current exec edge with schema break_others_a; the new target must be empty. Native dispatch rechecks the guard after checkpoint. Compile/save flags must remain false. Reconnecting the old path is a separate explicit action; failure can leave a partial chain, never an atomic transaction. Existing connect_graph_pins remains replacement-free with its original signature and journal fingerprint.

        CubelessBlueprintGraphTools.add_blueprint_event_node and the new add_blueprint_parent_function_call extension share the same durable action core. Their existing graph selectors, JSON positions and explicit unsupported options match the named tools. No implicit wiring/full compile/save. Actor Blueprint parents are admitted only by the saved clean compiled chain/dependency guard; native parent creation/duplication defaults and replay fingerprints remain unchanged. Component getters support the audited local generated ActorComponent scope described by their individual tool.

        Returns:
            data_json.batch contains ordered child results, attempted/observed changes, partial results, skipped steps, per-step compile/save, forced-stop reason and timing. Full compilation/saving occur in explicitly requested actions; engine factories and structural edits may perform separately reported implicit compiler work. One transaction scope does not promise atomic rollback, disk recovery or all-action Undo support. Completed reads replay historical results for the same ID. Long asynchronous work and full legacy command coverage are not implemented.

tools.description:
Set the legacy named physics-default group on one local unregistered component template. Supports exact Engine StaticMeshComponent, SphereComponent, BoxComponent and CapsuleComponent only. Uses public physics setters and independently observes stored defaults; no physics simulation, full compile or save is requested or verified. Inherited/native templates, external propagation and live physics state are unsupported. Corrects the old handler's ignored gravity_enabled input.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Exact /Game Blueprint package/object path or simple name under /Game/Blueprints. Selectors are at most 1023 UTF-16 units without controls.
            component_name: Exact reachable local SCS variable name; unsupported component types fail before requested editing.
            simulate_physics: Boolean, default True. Sets the template simulation default, not a running simulation.
            gravity_enabled: Boolean, default True. Applied through the public gravity setter; legacy_gravity_ignored_fixed records this intentional behavior correction.
            mass: Kilogram override, default 1.0. Finite number from 0.001 to 1e12; booleans/strings/null are rejected. The lower bound follows the public BodyInstance editor mass constraint and is stricter than legacy. Native storage is float32 and reports its actual rounded value.
            linear_damping: Finite number from 0 to 1e12, default 0.01; bool/string/null rejected. Same float32 observation rule as mass.
            angular_damping: Finite number from 0 to 1e12, default 0.0; bool/string/null rejected. Same float32 observation rule as mass.
            operation_id: Optional durable ID; omitted/null generates a returned ID. One journal and action core are shared by standalone and named batch use. Replays never execute again; partial or unknown outcomes require inspection and are never automatically retried.

        Returns:
            Standard mutation outcome retaining data.component, physics_before/physics_after, legacy_gravity_ignored_fixed and runtime_simulation_verified=false. Actual changes and no-op results remain explicit. No atomic rollback is promised.

tools.description:
Set the mesh and/or material slot 0 of an exact native StaticMeshComponent in the Blueprint's reachable local SCS. Preserves the legacy named tool, Cube default, positional operation_id and data.component result while restoring the old native material branch. Both requested references are prevalidated before editing; invalid references fail explicitly instead of silent success. No full compile or save is requested. Supported classes/dependencies/propagation remain bounded, not full internal-command parity.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Exact /Game Blueprint package/object path or simple name under /Game/Blueprints. Inherited/native CDO templates, custom component subclasses and external instance propagation are unsupported.
            component_name: Exact reachable local component variable name, at most 1023 UTF-16 units without controls. A non-StaticMeshComponent fails explicitly.
            static_mesh: /Engine or /Game StaticMesh package/object path, default /Engine/BasicShapes/Cube.Cube. For material-only edits, explicitly pass an empty string AND a valid material path. An empty mesh without a material remains invalid. Omission selects Cube even when material is supplied; null is not a leave-unchanged sentinel because the official conversion can apply the Cube default. Complete paths are at most 1023 UTF-16 units. General set_component_property with JSON null is a distinct mesh-clear operation.
            operation_id: Optional durable ID; omitted/null generates a returned ID. Its positional location is preserved. Mesh-only normalized arguments and existing journal replay remain unchanged. Replay never executes again; unknown results are not automatically retried.
            material: Optional /Engine or /Game material package/object path to assign slot 0; omitted/null leaves materials unchanged. Empty/malformed paths fail and do not clear. Complete paths are at most 1023 UTF-16 units. Native runtime class, dependency and slot readback guards apply; unsupported material subclasses or external archetypes fail.
